units.time_h: hours of simulated time to the cell's target (5-eval mean)
units.gb: cumulative wire GB at that time
units.slot_time_h: slot-hours over the whole run (to the hit or 120 h): useful / discarded compute, held by a departed client, waiting at the barrier, idle

meta.notes: status hit = reached target, miss = ran to the end without it (final_acc, peak_acc5), pending = leg not done
